source.name: TGR Haas F1 Team – Partners: Singha
source.quote: TGR Haas F1 Team is proud to announce a new partnership with Singha Corporation ahead of the 2026 FIA Formula 1 World Championship

note: On the 2026 team shirt the Singha mark sits at the top of the sleeve stack (store product photos); on the VF-26 car it is on the rear wing (Sector, 2026-01-19).
